derivation:
by
  rw [ae_iff, show {q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | ¬q.2.1 ≠ 0} = univ ×ˢ ({0} ×ˢ univ) by ext q; simp]
  simp only [Measure.prod_prod, measure_singleton, zero_mul, mul_zero]
explanation: The exceptional set is univ ×ˢ ({0} ×ˢ univ). Applying the product-measure formula twice reduces its measure to zero by singleton simplification.
